intro: MacPherson Weave is an HDB project in Geylang, in the MacPherson part of the town. A third-party completion estimate is on file, but this entry is not officially confirmed: HDB has not verified a project-wide key date, and tracker sources have disagreed on the month. Unit counts and any estimated month are therefore left out of the facts below. If you have an HDB key-appointment letter, use that. We will not publish a tracker month as if it were official. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your MacPherson Weave renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your MacPherson Weave interior
sections.text:
MacPherson sits in a fine-grain, central-east part of the island, between older Geylang streets and newer housing. Owners approaching keys here usually want a first fit-out that is practical in a compact HDB plan: a fitted kitchen that can take daily cooking, full-height wardrobes, an entry shoe cabinet, and a living-room joinery wall rather than a loose television bench. Maison designs that work as built-in carpentry, not as IKEA-style furniture, and we can show a wide room or a closer study of a wardrobe, a kitchen run or a headboard wall. We have no official floor plan on file and will not invent typologies or a typical MacPherson Weave layout.

Dakota Crest and Merpati Meadow are the other Geylang pages in this batch. Merpati Meadow is a November 2026 BTO launch and is at a different stage; do not use its launch date as a key date for MacPherson Weave. Grand Dunman, already live in District 15, is a nearby private-housing link, not a typologies reference. We will not invent walking times to MacPherson MRT, to Geylang, or to Paya Lebar.

After keys, inspect defects, measure, and obtain the HDB renovation permit before any carpentry is fabricated. A moderate, non-structural carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals — an editorial allowance, not a guarantee. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and any key letter you have. We are not affiliated with HDB.
